channel.desc: Max and Ellis investigate a locked-room mystery after the death of a high-powered fixer electrocuted in her penthouse hot tub, where she was the only one present at the time; actors, Vanessa Morgan, Giacomo Gianniotti, Jason Priestley, Tamara Taylor, Terry Chen, Amy Goodmurphy, Fletcher Donovan, Kaylah Zander.
